title: NoTB: Oracle-Free Triage of LLM-Generated RTL via Cross-Model Formal Consensus
abstract: arXiv:2608.21962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs from natural-language specifications. However, assessing functional correctness at early stages remains a fundamental challenge. Existing oracle-free approaches rely either on simulation-based agreement, which depends on LLM-generated testbenches that can fail or vary across models, or on LLM-as-a-judge heuristics, which produce inconsistent predictions. We introduce NoTB, an oracle-free triage framework that infers correctness from cross-model formal consensus. NoTB generates RTL implementations from multiple independently trained LLM families and applies Sequential Equivalence Checking (SEC) to identify designs that are provably equivalent. We show that the diversity of model families within an SEC-equivalent cluster induces a calibrated correctness signal, enabling risk-coverage tradeoffs without requiring testbenches. On 78 CVDP RTL

translated_title: NoTB：通过跨模型形式化共识对LLM生成的RTL进行无参考标准的分诊
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21962v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于从自然语言规范生成寄存器传输级（RTL）设计。然而，在早期阶段评估功能正确性仍然是一个基本挑战。现有的无参考标准方法要么依赖于基于仿真的协议，这依赖于LLM生成的测试平台，这些测试平台可能失败或在不同模型间变化，要么依赖于LLM作为评判者的启发式方法，这会产生不一致的预测。我们引入了NoTB，一种无参考标准的分诊框架，它从跨模型形式化共识中推断正确性。NoTB从多个独立训练的LLM家族生成RTL实现，并应用序列等价性检查（SEC）来识别可证明等价的设计。我们表明，SEC等价簇内模型家族的多样性会诱导出校准的正确性信号，从而无需测试平台即可实现风险覆盖权衡。在78个CVDP RTL上
tldr: NoTB提出了一种无需测试平台和参考标准的分诊方法，通过多LLM家族的序列等价性检查共识来校准RTL设计的正确性信号。
en_tdlr: NoTB introduces an oracle-free triage method that calibrates correctness signals for RTL designs via sequential equivalence checking consensus across multiple LLM families, eliminating the need for testbenches.
